description:
Moon Cheol-joo, a freshman in high school, is a soccer prospect with stronger legs than anyone else.  
During the match, Cheol-ju is unable to contain his anger and assaults his opponent, receiving a severe punishment and facing a crisis on his path to becoming a soccer player.  
There are good friends around Cheol-ju, and Cheol-ju tries to find stability with the support of his friends and the love of his lady friend, Eun-seo Chin.  
With the help of his friend Lee Young-min, Cheol-ju manages to hold back his anger and dreams of becoming the owner of a five-story building.  
With the guidance and help of the adults around him (director, therapist, parents), Cheol-ju decides to enter a separate soccer program for his future as a soccer player.  
However, when his parents are scammed and his family suddenly finds himself in an economic crisis, the main character, a 17-year-old minor, decides to earn money and jumps into a high-paying, extreme job called 'mountain porter'.  
'Cheongun Sanjang' is located in the middle of Bukhansan Mountain. Cheol-ju breaks away from the fence of 'school' and works as a porter belonging to a mountain hut, experiences the people of the mountain lodge and their world, builds up the power of life, and furthermore sees another dream.  
And friends and colleagues who are directly or indirectly connected to this departure of Cheol-ju have their own intentions and practice those intentions.  
can do anything, but The time when it is difficult to do anything, their story.  
A youth growth drama that shares love and friendship through trial and execution, challenge and practice.
